caseName: New Orleans Public Belt Railroad v. Davis
caseNameFull: New Orleans Public Belt Railroad v. James Davis
attorneys: Messrs. W. L. Gleason and E. M. Miner for defendant in error, in support of the motion., Mr. Percy S. Benedict for plaintiff in error, in opposition thereto. •

opinions.text: Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Central Land Co. v. Laidley, 159 U. S. 103, 112; Tracy v. Ginzberg, 205 U. S. 170, 178; Bonner v. Gorman, 213 U. S. 86, 91; Milwaukee Electric Ry. Co. v. Milwaukee, 253 U. S. 100, 106.
